editorial:
Imagine waking up to find your baby brother snatched by a swarm of crows and taken into a secret, magical forest. That is exactly what happens to Prue, who has to team up with her classmate Curtis to get him back. You will love how the movie balances the scary parts with a lot of heart and humor. The world feels huge and alive, filled with talking animals and strange magic that makes you feel like you are right there on the adventure. It feels like a classic fairy tale but with a modern twist that keeps things fresh and exciting.

The animation is absolutely stunning, and the chemistry between Prue and Curtis makes the journey feel real. While some of the middle parts drag a bit, the big action scenes more than make up for it. If you have a nice setup at home, you should definitely stream this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the colorful details. If you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move. It is a perfect pick for a family movie night that will leave you feeling happy.
endingExplained: In the final battle, Prue discovers that she has a hidden connection to the forest's magic. She uses this power to outsmart Alexandra and free her baby brother from the crows. The twist is that Alexandra wanted the baby to restart the forest's ancient magic for herself. Once the baby is safe, the crows stop being evil and peace returns. Prue and Curtis return home, forever changed by their big adventure.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves magical worlds and brave kids.
